decisions.reason: The atlas contains small architectural, nautical and heraldic map icons and ornamental frames. Review of all twelve stored palette banks found no Japanese instruction or caption requiring translation. Preserve the original designs, geometry and palettes.

The small East Asian building icons include a painted lantern and architectural shop signs. These marks are integrated physical setting artwork, rather than separate menu labels or instructions. Preserve their source pixels instead of inventing English shop names or transcriptions from indistinct strokes. All nine stored palette banks retain the same icon geometry.
decisions.relation_to_previous_kbj_decisions: The physical-sign retention rationale is consistent with kbj04 and kbj08. These four-bit atlas icons are different artwork from the eight-bit loose kbj images; exact pixel equivalence and a shared native consumer are not asserted.

visual_review: All eight current source-comparison and palette-bank sheets opened and reviewed.
